channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Reports: St. Louis Blues' Colton Parayko Turns Down Trade To Buffalo Sabres
item.description: The Blues reportedly had an agreement with the Sabres to trade Colton Parayko, but the veteran defenseman chose not to waive his no-trade clause, according to multiple reports.

item.title: NHL Waivers: Seven Players Waived, Blues To Terminate Joseph's Contract
item.description: Recent Devils trade acquisition Maxim Tsyplakov is on NHL waivers, along with six others on four teams. Blues right winger Mathieu Joseph, meanwhile, could become a UFA on Friday.

item.title: Paralympics 2026: Full Para Hockey Roster List
item.description: Para hockey runs from March 7 to 15 at the 2026 Paralympics in Milan, where the United States will look to win their fifth straight gold medal.

item.title: The Wraparound: Reacting To Latest Trades On NHL Trade Deadline Day Eve
item.description: Emma Lingan, Michael Augello and Kelsey Surmacz discuss the latest trades before Friday's deadline, Kiefer Sherwood's contract extension, Sergei Bobrovsky's future and more.

item.title: Buffalo Sabres Must Try Again To Attract Talent After Failed Colton Parayko Trade
item.description: The Buffalo Sabres thought they'd turned a corner as a destination for NHL players in trades, but St. Louis Blues D-man Colton Parayko did not waive his no-move clause to join them.

item.title: Former Oilers, Wild, Sharks Goalie Devan Dubnyk Describes The Times He Got Traded
item.description: Devan Dubnyk said his first time getting traded was difficult because he hadn't experienced it before. He ended up being traded five times and described a "really, really classy" decision by then-Sharks GM Doug Wilson.

item.title: Penguins' Malkin Gets Game Misconduct For Slashing Sabres' Dahlin In The Head
item.description: Pittsburgh Penguins veteran center Evgeni Malkin received 17 penalty minutes, including a game misconduct, for slashing Buffalo Sabres defenseman Rasmus Dahlin.

item.title: Ottawa Senators Change Up The Wing By Adding Warren Foegele And Trading David Perron
item.description: The Ottawa Senators picked up Warren Foegele, a left winger who's signed for one more year, while trading pending UFA David Perron.

item.title: Canucks Trade Conor Garland To Blue Jackets Months Before His Contract Extension Kicks In
item.description: The Columbus Blue Jackets brought in playmaking right winger Conor Garland from the Vancouver Canucks before the NHL trade deadline. His six-year contract extension takes effect in July.

item.title: Anaheim Ducks Acquire Longtime Washington Capitals D-Man John Carlson
item.description: The Anaheim Ducks bring in Stanley Cup champion and former first-team all-star defenseman John Carlson from the Washington Capitals ahead of the NHL trade deadline.
